爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD014 樱空翼Sakura Tsubasa-她的颤栗邀请
她斜倚墙角，紫眸半眯，红唇微张成诱人的“O”型，像在无声娇喘着邀请。
蓝缎旗袍紧裹着火辣身段，胸前红绳镂空处，丰满雪峰呼之欲出，随着呼吸轻轻颤动。
白绒毛边摩擦着敏感肌肤，蓝穗在指尖晃荡，仿佛在低语：“来吧……慢慢解开这些细绳，让我在你掌心轻轻颤栗，在你身下慢慢融化……”

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD014 Sakura Tsubasa-Her Trembling Invitation
She leaned against the corner of the wall, her purple eyes half-closed, her red lips slightly parted into an alluring "O" shape, as if silently panting an invitation.
A blue satin cheongsam tightly hugged her fiery figure, the red rope cutouts at the chest revealing her full, snowy breasts, which trembled gently with her breath.
White fur trim brushed against her sensitive skin, blue tassels swayed on her fingertips, as if whispering: "Come... slowly untie these thin ropes, let me tremble gently in your palm, slowly melt beneath you..."
